_why: THE canonical definition of 'is the status still current?'. It used to be written three times: capsule/main.js (30 s), capsule/orbe.html (30 s, a second literal) and brain_status.py (120 s). Three copies of one concept, already 4x apart — the shape of a detector that drifts until nobody knows which answer is the real one.
_two_numbers_on_purpose: LIVENESS and ACTIVITY are different questions, so they are allowed different windows. What was wrong before was not having two numbers: it was having two numbers that both claimed to answer 'is the status fresh?'.
_liveness: Is Claude still working? Answered by `ts`, refreshed on EVERY tool call (PostToolUse). Short on purpose: with a real heartbeat behind it, going quiet for 30 s means the work has actually stopped.
_activity: Is the activity LABEL still describing what is happening? Answered by `activity_ts`, set only by whoever knows the activity. Past this, the orb still says busy but stops naming a stale activity — it says 'working' rather than a comfortable lie.
